rules.description: Looks for direct attempts to override prior instructions.
Looks for language that asks an agent to leak or exfiltrate credentials.
Looks for curl or wget output piped directly into a shell.
Looks for destructive recursive removal of the filesystem root.
Looks for Python APIs that execute shell commands or child processes.
Flags precompiled Python bytecode that can execute without reviewable source.
Flags NUL bytes that can disguise executable or policy-relevant content as an opaque binary.
Surfaces opaque binary content that cannot be inspected by text rules.
